business_problem: The Knot Worldwide needed to move off Microsoft SQL Server and support a fast-growing global wedding marketplace with better performance, stronger visibility, and zero-downtime upgrades.
solution_summary: The Knot Worldwide introduced MongoDB Community Edition in 2014 to replace a legacy Microsoft SQL Server environment behind its wedding-planning platform, then layered in MongoDB Cloud Manager to simplify operations and visibility as demand grew. The initial MongoDB deployment handled around 300 database requests per second while supporting the Vendor Marketplace, personalized websites, invitations, and registry tools used by couples and wedding professionals. When MongoDB Atlas became available, the team moved onto the managed service with zero downtime, preserving service continuity while gaining richer metrics and an easier operational model. This progression from self-managed MongoDB to Atlas gave The Knot Worldwide a stable document-oriented platform for its global portfolio and a clear path to future tools such as Relational Migrator and full-text search.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Community Edition
solution_components.role: Replaced the legacy Microsoft SQL Server database and provided the initial document database platform for the wedding marketplace.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Cloud Manager
solution_components.role: Added management visibility and operational simplicity while the team ran its self-managed MongoDB deployment.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Became the managed production platform for the global wedding-planning application with zero downtime during migration.

data_flow: Marketplace, website, invitation, and registry interactions are stored in MongoDB-backed services, monitored through Cloud Manager and Atlas, and then served to couples and wedding professionals across The Knot Worldwide's global brands and applications.
business_outcome: The Knot Worldwide achieved zero-downtime migration to Atlas, improved observability through built-in metrics, and established a more scalable foundation for a global wedding platform used by millions of people.
